source.notes: arch-008 (A13 score/reducer). FoX / Forgetting Attention: K1 score = qk^T·scale + gc_i − gc_j with gc = cumsum(logsigmoid(f)) (per head), causal (optionally windowed), softmax, @v. The cumulative-log-gate bias is data-dependent — no softmax-only or fixed-pairwise-bias materialization claim (sweep verdict). The bias is computed externally (cumsum) and passed as the K1 score_bias operand: the existing additive-score-bias K1 contract already covers this score algebra (no new descriptor field). Verified against fla/ops/forgetting_attn/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/forgetting_attention.py.
